purpose: Index of the complete evidence bundles supporting the maintained results. Verify each release manifest before review.

balanced_v2.scope: Three registered consequence mechanisms, Knowledge Work and Engineering, Sol 5.6 and 6.1; five positives and seven preserved negatives with native, ATIF and independent-review evidence.

formation_examples.scope: Four domains under information-dependent and impossible historical formation inputs. Each case retains its own frozen source and original score; these examples are not stitched to balanced-v2 consequence cells.

archive_policy: Superseded development reports and release-by-release indexes remain in Git history and private GitHub Releases. They are not current benchmark results.
